question: What final state does the chief yogin attain at the end of the body?
premises: The chief yogin reaches the end of the body.
The attained state is supreme bliss.
That state is identified as brahman-liberation.
inference: At bodily death the chief yogin attains the supreme bliss of brahman-liberation.
plain_english: At the end of the body, the chief yogin goes to the supreme state of bliss, which is liberation in Brahman.
